name: aiditor-vscode
description: Quizzes you on your staged changes before you commit, to make sure you actually reviewed AI-generated code (not just accepted it).

aiditor.provider.description: Which LLM backend generates and grades quiz questions. 'vscode-lm' uses VS Code's built-in Language Model API (needs Copilot or another model provider extension). 'byok' calls Anthropic/OpenAI directly with your own API key.

aiditor.byokProvider.description: Which API to call when aiditor.provider is 'byok'.

aiditor.byokModel.description: Model name to request for BYOK calls (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o).

aiditor.vscodeLmFamily.description: Model family to request via vscode.lm. Must be available through an installed model provider (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

aiditor.questionCount.description: Number of questions to generate per review.

aiditor.allowShortAnswer.description: Allow free-text questions (graded by the LLM against a rubric), not just multiple choice. Free-text questions are harder to pass by guessing.

aiditor.passThreshold.description: Fraction of questions that must be answered correctly to pass (0-1).

aiditor.bridgePort.description: Local port the running extension listens on so the pre-commit hook can reach it.

aiditor.failClosedOnError.description: If true, an internal error (e.g. LLM API failure) blocks the commit. If false, errors fail open and the commit is allowed, so a bug in this extension can't brick your workflow.
